text:
sarah_sales: quick heads-up — POC customer (fintech startup) asked for dedicated commit quote. They want 4x A100 reserved, ability to autoscale + 2x burst GPUs for spikes. Asking for a 20% off list on committed pool for a 12mo term. need approval path and any immediate no-go items.

tyler_revenue_ops: 20% is steep for A100 reserved. what’s their expected sustained utilization? we usually gate deeper discounts on utilization or multiyear.

sarah_sales: they expect ~60% sustained, spikes up to 95% for batch runs. POC duration 3 months then scale. revenue est ~$40k/mo if we give commit.

lena_dealdesk: looped in. two quick things: (1) we have a precedent for a 15% commit discount at 60%+ utilization for 12mo. (2) burst GPU pricing is usually +50% of committed per-hour rate, not discounted. any technical constraints on burst + autoscale?

mike_eng_infra: technically fine but mixed-pool burst (A100 reserved + ephemeral V100/RTX for burst) needs compatibility in model quantization and kernel paths. performance variance is expected. autoscaler config: we can allow burst to spin up different GPU class but need explicit fallback policy.

anya_sales_eng: for the POC we can propose a carveout: committed 4x A100 @ 15% off, burst pool capped at 2x GPUs billed at 1.5x committed-hour rate, and a safety SLO that we won't route heavy realtime to burst GPUs. customer ok with limited realtime SLA in POC.

sarah_sales: that sounds reasonable. they also asked if we can waive the standard commit minimum onboarding fee for POC. is that doable?

lena_dealdesk: waive fee is a discretionary approval. need deal rationale + estimated ARR. please add the ARR and renewal cadence to the approval form. I can fast-track if ARR > $300k ARR or strong strategic signal.

tyler_revenue_ops: on auto-approve criteria: if utilization projection + ARR meets thresholds, finance will pre-approve up to 18% discount. anything beyond needs exec sign-off.

sarah_sales: ARR calc: if they convert to same scale after POC, projected ARR ~360k. forwarding that in form.

dealbot: <@lena_dealdesk> please review pricing request: https://redwood.internal/deals/submit — include: commitment size, utilization forecast, burst cap, SLO carveouts, expected ARR. Attach security questionnaire if customer wants private deployment.

mike_eng_infra: one more note — for billing clarity include a line item for "burst GPU usage" and the fallback variant (e.g., V100) so legal knows we’re not promising identical perf.

sarah_sales: will fill form now and attach POC statement + ARR calc. tagging @lena_dealdesk for fast-track.

lena_dealdesk: got it. if form submitted within 24h I’ll review EOD and flag any exec approval. if we need >18% discount we’ll route to finance + legal for carveouts.

anya_sales_eng: for the POC deployment plan I’ll prepare a short note on autoscale policy and model compatibility so infra can sign off.

sarah_sales: thanks team — filing now. ping back here once approved and I’ll update customer. :thumbsup:

(automated) dealbot: pricing request created (#DB-2024-1776) — review queue assigned to lena_dealdesk.
